opening.argument: The material shows a campaign being configured, not a completed solicitation. Its title frames the subject as generating Norton tech-support calls through Google AdWords, and the demonstration walks through audience targeting, Norton-related keywords, bidding, and draft ad text. The draft includes Norton activation and live-support language, but the platform also displays a policy warning that the ad needs to be fixed. The speaker discusses addressing fake clicks as part of the campaign setup. These are observable steps in an advertising tutorial. The evidence does not establish that the draft was published, that the advertiser lacked authorization, or that any transaction or confirmed victim-directed solicitation occurred.
